name: Strichoss
source:
A former policeman. He was in Musashi's "Youth Division" with Ruka, Ikuta and Sousuke and became a detective after that. He eventually left the police force to establish a private security company.
A human without special abilities, he is, however, highly skilled at gathering information through his own channels. 

[spoiler] He lost his lover because of the Cult's terrorist attack, but chose to hide this news from others. He left the police force after realizing that he couldn't have his revenge while he was a policeman. [/spoiler]
